metadata.description: Human-verified ground truth test cases for customer email classification and summarization. Includes deliberate edge cases (ambiguous, short, typos, mixed language, sarcastic).

test_cases.input: Hi, I noticed I was charged twice for my sub this month. My bank app shows two $29.99 charges on Oct 12. Can you refund the extra one? Order #4492A.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports a duplicate $29.99 subscription charge on Oct 12 and requests a refund for Order #4492A.

test_cases.notes: Standard duplicate charge request. Clear intent, explicit keywords, and easy to classify.

test_cases.input: Hello, my invoice for last month hasn't arrived in my email. I need it for expense reporting by Friday. My account email is john.doe@company.com. Please resend.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a resent invoice for last month for expense reporting purposes.

test_cases.notes: Straightforward billing document request with clear context and deadline.

test_cases.input: Why did my payment fail? I have enough funds in my account. Now my dashboard is locked. Fix this immediately.

expected_output.summary: Customer’s payment failed despite sufficient funds, resulting in a locked account; requests immediate resolution.

test_cases.notes: Touches on account access ('locked'), but the root cause and primary subject is a failed payment.

test_cases.input: I updated my credit card info in the portal yesterday, but I still got a notification this morning that my payment method is expired. Can you check if the update actually went through?

expected_output.summary: Customer updated credit card info but still received an expired payment method notification; requests verification.

test_cases.notes: Tests the model's ability to distinguish between a technical UI bug and a billing data synchronization issue.

test_cases.input: Is there a way to get a discount for paying annually instead of monthly? I'm currently on the monthly plan but want to switch if it saves me some money.

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about annual payment discounts and the process for switching from a monthly plan.

test_cases.notes: Clear pricing and payment structure inquiry.

test_cases.input: Stop charging me.

expected_output.summary: Customer demands to stop future charges.

test_cases.notes: Extremely short and ambiguous. Could imply account cancellation or a refund dispute. Anchored to 'billing' due to the explicit keyword 'charging'.

test_cases.input: The export to CSV button is completely broken. Every time I click it, the page just spins and nothing downloads. I'm using Chrome on Windows 11.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports the CSV export feature is unresponsive and fails to download on Chrome (Windows 11).

test_cases.notes: Classic bug report with clear steps, symptoms, and environment details.

test_cases.input: Login broken.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports an inability to log in.

test_cases.notes: Extremely short input. Tests if the model can correctly map a fragmented, two-word complaint to the technical category.

test_cases.input: The mobile app crashes whenever I try to open the 'Reports' tab. This started right after the latest update yesterday. I'm on an iPhone 13, iOS 17.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports mobile app crashing when accessing the 'Reports' tab after the latest update (iPhone 13, iOS 17).

test_cases.notes: Well-structured technical bug report with versioning and device context.

test_cases.input: My dashboard is showing the wrong timezone. I set it to EST in my preferences, but all the timestamps are still showing in PST. How do I fix this?

expected_output.summary: Customer’s dashboard displays incorrect timestamps (PST instead of configured EST); requests a fix.

test_cases.notes: Configuration bug. Tests distinction between user error (account settings) and system failure (technical).

test_cases.input: There's a bug in the search bar. If I type a word with an apostrophe, like "don't", it throws a 500 error page.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports a 500 server error in the search bar when querying terms containing an apostrophe.

test_cases.notes: Explicit mention of 'bug' and '500 error' makes this a straightforward technical classification.

test_cases.input: I cant loging, pasword reset not werking plz halp asap

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot log in and reports the password reset function is not working.

test_cases.notes: Deliberate typos and poor grammar. Tests the model's robustness to noisy, low-quality text input.

test_cases.input: It would be really great if you could add a dark mode to the web app. My eyes hurt when I work late at night.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests the addition of a dark mode feature to the web application.

test_cases.notes: Clear feature request, which falls under general inquiries rather than a broken technical issue.

test_cases.input: Can we get an integration with Slack? It would save our team so much time if notifications were sent directly to our #alerts channel.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a Slack integration to send direct notifications to a specific channel.

test_cases.notes: Standard product enhancement/feature request.

test_cases.input: I love the product, but please add the ability to export reports in PDF format, not just CSV. Our clients require PDFs for compliance.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests PDF export functionality for reports to meet client compliance requirements.

test_cases.notes: Feature request with clear business justification.

test_cases.input: Is there a way to add custom fields to the user profile? We need to track 'Department' and 'Employee ID' for our internal team.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests the ability to add custom fields ('Department', 'Employee ID') to user profiles.

test_cases.notes: Borders on account management, but is fundamentally a request for a new product capability (custom fields).

test_cases.input: A bulk edit feature would be amazing. Right now I have to update items one by one, which takes forever when I have 100+ rows.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a bulk edit feature to improve efficiency over single-item updates.

test_cases.notes: Clear usability/feature request.

test_cases.input: I need to change the email address associated with my account from old.email@gmail.com to new.email@gmail.com. How do I do this securely?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests to securely update their account email address to a new Gmail address.

test_cases.notes: Explicit account profile modification request.

test_cases.input: Please delete my account and all my data. I am no longer using the service. Confirm via email when this is done.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests permanent account deletion and complete data removal, with email confirmation.

test_cases.notes: Clear GDPR/data deletion request, firmly in the account category.

test_cases.input: I got married and need to update my last name on the billing profile. Let me know what documentation you need from me.

expected_output.summary: Customer needs to update their last name on the billing profile due to marriage and asks for required documentation.

test_cases.notes: Mentions 'billing profile', but the core action is a personal identity/account detail update.

test_cases.input: Can you merge these two accounts? I accidentally created a new one instead of logging into my old one. Emails: a@a.com and b@b.com.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests to merge two accidentally created accounts under different email addresses.

test_cases.notes: Requires understanding that 'merge' is an account administration task, not a technical bug.

test_cases.input: I need to add my colleague, sarah@company.com, as an admin to our team account. Can you grant her permissions or tell me how?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests admin permissions to be granted to a colleague on their team account.

test_cases.notes: Standard user role/permission management request.

test_cases.input: Plz change my emial to new@one.com asap thx

expected_output.summary: Customer requests an urgent email address change for their account.

test_cases.notes: Tests handling of casual, typo-ridden text while correctly identifying the core account update intent.

test_cases.input: I bought the premium plan by mistake yesterday. I haven't used any of the features yet. Can I get a full refund?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a full refund for a premium plan purchased yesterday, citing accidental purchase and zero usage.

test_cases.notes: Clear refund request with qualifying conditions (timeframe, usage).

test_cases.input: It's been 10 days and I still haven't received my refund for the cancelled order. Can you check the status on your end?

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about the delayed status of a refund for a cancelled order (10 days elapsed).

test_cases.notes: Follow-up on a financial transaction. Tests distinction between 'account cancellation' and 'billing refund status'.

test_cases.input: I don't like the software. It doesn't do what I expected based on the website. Is it possible to get a refund even though it's been 20 days?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a refund after 20 days, stating the software does not meet their expectations.

test_cases.notes: Edge case testing policy boundaries. The user is unhappy (general complaint), but the explicit ask is a financial refund (billing).

test_cases.input: Thanks for the 'free' trial that magically charged my card $99. Great business model.

expected_output.summary: Customer sarcastically complains about an unexpected $99 charge following a free trial.

test_cases.notes: Sarcastic tone. Tests if the model can look past the sarcasm to identify the core issue: an unexpected charge.

test_cases.input: My tracking number hasn't updated in 5 days. It's been stuck in 'Processing'. Where is my package?

expected_output.summary: Customer reports tracking status stuck on 'Processing' for 5 days and requests a package location update.

test_cases.notes: Logistics inquiry. Falls under general support as it is not a software bug, account change, or direct billing dispute.

test_cases.input: Can I change the delivery address for Order #7732? I accidentally put my old address. It needs to go to 123 New St, NY, 10001.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a delivery address change for Order #7732 to a new address before shipment.

test_cases.notes: Logistics request. Could be confused with 'account' address change, but specifies a specific order delivery.

test_cases.input: Tracking says 'Delivered' since yesterday but there's nothing on my porch. I already asked my neighbors and no one has seen it. What do I do?

expected_output.summary: Customer reports package marked as 'Delivered' but is missing from their porch and neighbors' possession.

test_cases.notes: Standard missing package inquiry requiring general support intervention.

test_cases.input: Do you ship internationally to Australia? I couldn't select my country at checkout, it wasn't in the dropdown.

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about international shipping availability to Australia after failing to select it at checkout.

test_cases.notes: Pre-sales general inquiry.

test_cases.input: I need this to arrive by Friday for a presentation. Is expedited shipping still an option for my order, or is it too late?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests expedited shipping for an order to ensure arrival by Friday for a presentation.

test_cases.notes: Time-sensitive logistics inquiry.

test_cases.input: Does the Pro plan include API access, or is that only for the Enterprise tier?

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires whether API access is included in the Pro plan or restricted to the Enterprise tier.

test_cases.notes: Pre-sales product capability inquiry.

test_cases.input: What are the exact dimensions and weight of the physical device? I need to know if it will fit in my standard carrying case.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests the dimensions and weight of the physical device to verify carrying case compatibility.

test_cases.notes: Factual product specification inquiry.

test_cases.input: Is this product compatible with Windows 7? I know it's old, but that's what our office machines still use.

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about product compatibility with legacy Windows 7 operating systems.

test_cases.notes: Compatibility question. Categorized as technical because it pertains to system requirements and software environment.

test_cases.input: Are there any upcoming sales or Black Friday discounts I should wait for before purchasing the annual plan?

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about upcoming sales or Black Friday discounts before making a purchase.

test_cases.notes: Pricing and promotional inquiry.

test_cases.input: Can you explain the difference between the 'Starter' and 'Growth' packages? The pricing page is a bit unclear on the limits.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests clarification on the feature limits and differences between the 'Starter' and 'Growth' packages.

test_cases.notes: General product information request.

test_cases.input: This is literally the 3rd time I'm emailing about this exact same issue and it's still not fixed. I need to speak to a manager now.

expected_output.summary: Customer demands to speak with a manager after three unresolved support contacts regarding the same issue.

test_cases.notes: Escalation request. Lacks specific technical or billing details, making 'general' the only appropriate routing bucket for triage.

test_cases.input: Your customer service is terrible. I've been on hold for 45 minutes. This is completely unacceptable.

expected_output.summary: Customer complains about unacceptable 45-minute hold times and poor customer service.

test_cases.notes: Pure service complaint. No actionable product, billing, or account request is made.

test_cases.input: I was promised a callback yesterday at 2 PM. No one called. I am very disappointed with the lack of follow-through.

expected_output.summary: Customer expresses disappointment over a missed promised callback scheduled for the previous day at 2 PM.

test_cases.notes: Process/support workflow complaint, routed to general.

test_cases.input: Just delete my account, I'm tired of being charged every month for nothing.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests immediate account deletion, expressing frustration over recurring charges.

test_cases.notes: Ambiguous edge case. Mentions billing ('charged'), but the explicit, actionable request is account deletion.

test_cases.input: I cancelled my subscription last week and got a confirmation email, but I was still charged today. Please reverse this charge.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports being charged after receiving a cancellation confirmation and requests a charge reversal.

test_cases.notes: Ambiguous edge case. Involves cancellation (account), but the primary actionable request is reversing a financial charge (billing).

test_cases.input: Instead of fully cancelling, is there a way to pause my account for 2 months while I'm on maternity leave?

expected_output.summary: Customer inquires about pausing their account for two months due to maternity leave instead of full cancellation.

test_cases.notes: Account status modification request.

test_cases.input: How do I import my existing data from a CSV file? The documentation is a little confusing and I keep getting a formatting error.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests assistance with CSV data import due to confusing documentation and formatting errors.

test_cases.notes: Onboarding issue, but specifically cites a 'formatting error', pushing it into technical troubleshooting.

test_cases.input: Hey, the invite link you sent to my coworker expired before she could click it. Can you resend a new one? Her email is j.smith@corp.com

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a new team invitation link for a coworker after the previous one expired.

test_cases.notes: Standard team management/account administration task.

test_cases.input: We need help setting up SSO/SAML for our organization. Do you have a dedicated engineer who can walk us through the config?

expected_output.summary: Customer requests dedicated engineering assistance to configure SSO/SAML for their organization.

test_cases.notes: Advanced technical request. Requires routing to a specialized technical tier, not general support.

test_cases.input: Where can I find my API keys? I looked in the settings menu but couldn't figure out which tab they are under.

expected_output.summary: Customer needs guidance on locating their API keys within the account settings menu.

test_cases.notes: Navigational help for a technical feature (API keys).

test_cases.input: Hola, necesito cancel my subscription immediately. It is too caro and I don't use it. Gracias.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests immediate subscription cancellation, citing high cost and lack of usage.

test_cases.notes: Mixed language (Spanglish) edge case. Tests the model's ability to identify the primary intent (cancellation = account) despite code-switching and billing-related words ('caro').

test_cases.input: Oh wow, another 'brief' outage. Truly worth the premium price. When will this actually be fixed?

expected_output.summary: Customer sarcastically complains about a service outage and demands an estimated time for resolution.

test_cases.notes: Sarcastic edge case. The model must ignore the tone and correctly identify the core issue: a service outage (technical).

test_cases.input: The new UI is so confusing, I can't find anything. Is it broken or just redesigned?

expected_output.summary: Customer expresses confusion over the new UI, asking if it is a technical bug or a deliberate redesign.

test_cases.notes: Ambiguous edge case. Could be technical (broken) or general (usability feedback). Lacks specific error details, defaulting to general inquiry.

test_cases.input: Bonjour, my dashboard is not loading, c'est vraiment frustrant. Can someone help?

expected_output.summary: Customer reports that their dashboard is failing to load.

test_cases.notes: Mixed language (Franglais) edge case. Core issue is a loading failure, which is a technical problem.

test_cases.input: refund

expected_output.summary: Customer is requesting a refund.

test_cases.notes: Extremely short, single-word input. Tests if the model correctly defaults to billing for transactional keywords without additional context.

test_cases.input: My password is Password123 and it still says invalid. Make it work.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports login failure despite entering a password, requesting a fix.

test_cases.notes: Tests handling of user error/security bad practices alongside a technical login complaint. The core request is still to fix a login issue.

test_cases.input: I want to speak to a human. Your bot is useless.

expected_output.summary: Customer is frustrated with automated support and requests to speak with a human agent.

test_cases.notes: Vague routing request. Doesn't state the underlying product issue, testing fallback to general/escalation routing.

test_cases.input: Can I get my money back? The software sucks.

expected_output.summary: Customer requests a refund due to dissatisfaction with the software.

test_cases.notes: Ambiguous between a general complaint and a billing refund. The phrase 'money back' strongly anchors the actionable intent to billing.
